features.holdBody: Park an unfinished order with Hold (F4). Resume or discard it later from Held orders (F3). Paying a resumed hold keeps the same order number.
features.ordersBody: Open Orders (F6) to see paid/refunded tickets from this session and reprint a receipt.
features.reconBody: Closing shows expected cash, sales by tender, and the difference vs counted cash. A reason is required when they differ. Held drafts must be cleared first.
features.payBody: Pay must be pressed twice (or F2 twice) to confirm and avoid misclicks. Each pay also sends an idempotency key so a retry will not charge twice. Split payments and bank terminal charge are supported.
features.splitBody: Use the scissors icon for equal (alla romana) or by-item splits. Pay one guest’s share, then continue with the rest.
features.customerBody: Search linked company users from the customer field. Walk-in names still work when no account is selected.
features.refundBody: From Session orders, refund a paid ticket in full or by line quantity. Stock restocks for returned lines when inventory is tracked.
features.stockBody: Tiles show on-hand qty. Oversell can be allowed per config. Multi-variant products open a picker; barcodes can resolve a specific variant.
features.pinBody: Configs can require a manager PIN for discounts, cash-out, and refunds. Set the PIN on the POS config.
